segments.oily: Oily and oily-combo reviewers mostly report a gentle, non-stripping cleanse, though a couple note it leaves an oily film or doesn't feel deeply cleansing on its own.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including several describing dry/dehydrated or perimenopausal skin, most consistently report the cleanser leaves skin soft, hydrated and not stripped, with no dry patches or tightness after use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as gentle and non-stripping, effective at removing daily makeup, with one preferring it as a morning cleanse rather than a deep clean.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea, eczema or reactive skin, report calming, non-irritating effects with no burning or redness, though a couple felt it was merely basic with no added benefit.
segments.mature: The few reviewers identifying as mature or in their 30s-40s report their skin looks and feels great with continued use.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing normal-to-oily skin found it gentle enough for daily use without stripping.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 30s-40s or describing perimenopausal skin report their skin looks and feels good with regular use; no negative reports specific to aging skin.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report elimination of dry patches and improved hydration and softness after use; no dissent noted.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or barrier damage report redness and inflammation calming down or disappearing within days to a week of use; no reports of increased redness among these users.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers rebuilding a damaged skin barrier report the cleanser soothed and repaired their skin without further irritation; no negative reports for barrier concerns specifically.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports rosacea bumps disappearing within a week and another reports blemishes clearing after days of use; a general reviewer separately noted no help with spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report reduced breakouts, calmer skin, or no new breakouts; however, one reviewer with acne reports the product made her acne worse and her face puffy and red, and one other reports gaining some acne while using it.
concerns.oiliness: Reports are mixed: some oily-skin reviewers say it still works well and leaves skin balanced, while others note it leaves an oily film requiring a second cleanser.

extraits.titre: Don't super love, don't super hate
extraits.texte: To start, it is on me for not fully reading the product description before purchasing this product lol. I love all things BYOMA so I kind of blindly bought this cleanser just because I trust and love this brand. Here are the pros: 1. It removes makeup pretty well with just one wash 2. it is a great size bottle for the price 3. It has not caused any adverse reactions for my sensitive, acne-prone, and redness-prone skin Here are some cons I have noticed: 1. This one is on me for sure, but I didn't realize it was a cleanser you have to apply to dry skin and then work in with water after. I wasn't necessarily looking for a product like this to be my everyday cleanser. 2. Although it is a good-sized bottle, you have to use a good 5-6 pumps to get nearly enough product to actually cover your face since it is applied to dry skin first. 3. I usually have to use a second cleanser after this one because it leaves my skin with an oily film. Maybe this is something good for the skin (IDK), but I don't personally love that because I already struggle with oily skin so I mainly use this as a first cleanse to remove makeup and then use something else as a double-cleanse. I can get by with just using this product at night since I'm sleeping and it doesn't matter if my skin looks a little extra oily lol but I definitely do not use this product alone in the mornings. I have come across so many cleansers that stripped my skin, and made my skin feel so much more dry than before I used it. But not this one. This brand and their products have single-handedly saved my skin. I have been using this cleanser and the byoma balancing mist, and every blemish on my face is gone within three days of me using their products! i will definitely be re-purchasing, and I would definitely recommend this to anyone that has acne prone skin!

I am OBSESSED with this cleanser! I have dry, dehydrated skin, and this cleanser is exactly what I needed. I've noticed that since using it for the past week that my skin doesn't have any dry patches and it actually looks so healthy! It truly has helped balance and normalize my skin. I've also been using it in conjunction with the toner from this same line and I think that really helped boost the hydration! The price point of this is great and the packaging is also super cute. I'm very happy with the results and it's definitely I product I'll be repurchasing for life! This was gifted by byoma but that did not sway my opinion.

TLDR: This cleanser is so terrible and I was left disappointed and felt like I fell into nice marketing appeal. Pros: dispenses easily, comes out smooth/milky Cons: left my skin feeling uncleansed and unrefreshed - need about 8 pumps to cleanse entire face and neck, and often felt like I needed to double cleanse. Personally, left my skin feeling under hydrated - yet also tons of oil build up during the day? Could be personal skin type, but probably won't purchase from this brand again. Overall, the brand felt cute and I was excited to try it. It was a major flop, and I was left feeling annoyed every time I washed my face, which is a major DONT ORDER AGAIN for me!
